name: Frikkdrop
source:
100 years after the fall of a meteorite which devastated mankind, its special energy has been used to sustain life in humanoid robots. The world remains in collapse as civilization perpetually threatens to fall into extinction.

Apocalypse future Sci-Fi digital novel game
- Play through 10 days in a pivotal time in history
- 2 concurrent scenarios merge into one grand story

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE070098.html]DLsite.com[/url]]
